Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class SessionPowerStatus

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.SessionPowerStatus
public final class SessionPowerStatus extends Object
Session power/lock actions for the 2D desktop's context menu.

Mirrors the PrinterStatus / TimeZoneStatus seam shape: the command-building is pure and unit-tested (lockCommand(boolean, boolean), suspendCommand(), rebootCommand(), poweroffCommand()); the available() probes are thin wrappers over PrinterStatus.exec(java.lang.String[]), and the actions are fire-and-forget child processes launched like Desktop2DAppRegistry.launchExternal(java.lang.String) (the DISPLAY inherited, the output drained, no exception propagated). On a host without loginctl / systemctl / xdg-screensaver every probe degrades to false so the matching menu entry simply does not appear, rather than failing.
